preset.header: Are you ready for the tutorial?
preset.text: Once enough people click Ready, the tutorial will start!
There are 33 spicy pepper cards in the game, numbered 3 to 35. Each card is worth that many points, e.g. the 11 card is worth 11 points.

params.name: format
params.value: Play an Eat! or Don't Eat! card.

preset.text: If you have a sequence of consecutive numbers, only the lowest card in that sequence counts for points. So if you have the 16, 17, and 18, you only receive 16 points!
Hover over a player's score in their video box to see what's in their hand!
